commit.message:
feat(skills): port dev-manager skill to node-template (#44)

Ports .claude/skills/dev-manager/SKILL.md from cogni (Cogni-DAO/cogni
origin/main) into node-template. The skill orchestrates N dev agents
against one story-level outcome: decompose into non-overlapping linked
tasks, inject guardrails, monitor claims/PRs, intervene on collision.

Node-fork adaptations:
- Substrate work-item/coordination calls target the NODE plane
  (https://<slug>.cognidao.org/api/v1, COGNI_NODE_API_KEY) instead of
  the operator plane.
- Guardrail step references node-template's real skills (add-secret,
  schema-update, test-expert) and the node ownership boundary.
- Sibling links: /validate-candidate (local) relative-linked; /promote
  referenced as a global skill.
